role_1_tate_adelic_character_normalizati.statement: For local p-adic characters psi_p(x_p) = exp(i * tau * {x_p}_p) with tau = 2*pi, the partial-fraction decomposition q = sum_p {q}_p + n(q) (n(q) in Z) on Q subset A_Q uniquely forces the archimedean character psi_inf(x_inf) = exp(-i * tau * x_inf) (c_inf = tau = 2*pi) so that prod_{v <= inf} psi_v(q) = 1 for all q in Q.

role_2_poisson_opposite_grade_lattice_du.statement: Under f_hat(y) = int_R f(x) exp(-i * tau * x * y) dx, scaling the spatial lattice Z -> tau^K Z scales the dual lattice to tau^{-K} Z with covolume product tau^K * tau^{-K} = 1, supplying opposite-grade Poisson summation sum_{n in Z} f(n * tau^K) = tau^{-K} sum_{m in Z} f_hat(m * tau^{-K}).

role_3_grade_base_and_algebraic_exponent.statement: For K in A_R = Qbar intersect R, the grade action U_K f(x) = tau^{-K/2} f(tau^{-K} x) places prime-power stations at n * tau^K (additive log-shifts log n + K log tau). By Lindemann-Weierstrass + Gelfond-Schneider, tau = 2*pi is transcendental and hence tau^q is transcendental for every nonzero rational q in Q \ {0}; we do NOT assume transcendence of tau^K for irrational algebraic K in A_R \ Q (an open Schanuel-type problem), whereas density of Q in A_R and R already suffices for the spectral/analytic continuation steps.

role_4_canonical_theta_gaussian_exponent.statement: The self-dual Gaussian exp(-(tau/2) x^2) = exp(-pi x^2) has quadratic exponent tau/2 = pi tied to the Fourier kernel exp(-i tau x y), so P(D) = D^2 - 1/16 (D = t d/dt) simultaneously annihilates the s = 0 (origin) and s = 1 (integral) poles.

arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.arithmetic_grade_shift_p_tau_K: D_{p,K} f(x) = f(p^{-1} tau^{-K} x), log-coordinate translation u |-> u - log p - K log tau
arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.analytic_prime_power_p_pow_tau_neg_K: A_K f(x) = f(x^{tau^{-K}}), log-coordinate scaling u |-> tau^{-K} u in Z_tau(s, K) = zeta(tau^{-K} s)
arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.semidirect_intertwining_law: D_J A_K = A_K D_{J * tau^{-K}}  and  A_K D_J = D_{J * tau^K} A_K  (in log-shift parameter J)
arithmetic_vs_analytic_prime_transformat.zeta_operator_grade_sampling_identity: Z(U_{-K} f)(1) = sum_{n>=1} (U_{-K} f)(n) = tau^{K/2} sum_{n>=1} f(n * tau^K) = tau^{K/2} (Z f)(tau^K)

quotient_data_retention_classification.unquotiented_graded_monoid_M_Z: Retains individual prime factors p, exponents k, and grade index K in (n, K) -> n * tau^K.
quotient_data_retention_classification.divisor_aggregated_profile_W_log: Applies sum_{d|k} Lambda(d) = log k via harmonic aggregation sum_{m>=1} m^{-1/2} W(X/m), cancelling all zeta-zero poles in |Re(z)| < 5/2 while retaining integer stations k >= 2; exact Moebius inversion W(X) = sum_{m>=1} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m) recovers all prime-power weights Lambda(n).
quotient_data_retention_classification.meyer_cotangent_quotient_H_minus_0: Quotients H_- by Z(H_+ intersect H_-), annihilating the trivial integer lattice sum while retaining all nontrivial zeros rho of xi(s) with exact multiplicities ord_xi(rho) and all local prime Weil distributions W_p in the character trace formula.
quotient_data_retention_classification.connes_consani_sonin_compression: Compresses the theta map by the projection S onto Sonin's space (functions vanishing along  with their Fourier transform on (-2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2})), retaining the archimedean + p=2 semilocal trace on supp(g) subset [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}] whileseparated grades |K - L| > log(2)/log(tau) extend support across all primes p >= 2.

connes_consani_moscovici_generator_ident.exact_ratio_identity: f_tau(x) = 8 * h_CCM(x)  and  x^{1/2} * Z(f_tau)(x) = 8 * k_CCM(x)

star_algebra_definition.algebra: C[A_R] generated by {V_K : K in A_R} with V_K V_J = V_{K+J}, V_0 = I, V_K^* = V_{-K}
star_algebra_definition.hilbert_realization: (U_K f)(x) = tau^{-K/2} f(tau^{-K} x) on L^2(R_+^x, dx/x) satisfies U_K^* = U_{-K}
star_algebra_definition.distinction_from_coordinate_conjugation: The star-involution V_K^* = V_{-K} is the Hilbert-space operator adjoint of unitary dilation U_K on L^2(R_+^x, dx/x), NOT complex conjugation of the real coordinate n * tau^K (which is already real and fixed by conjugation) and NOT unnormalized scaling f(tau^K x) (whose L^2 adjoint is tau^{-K} f(tau^{-K} x)).

character_compatibility_equivalence.star_compatibility_criterion: chi_rho(V_K^*) = conj(chi_rho(V_K))  <==>  tau^{-K * delta} = tau^{K * delta}  <==>  delta = Re(rho) - 1/2 = 0  (for any K != 0, since tau = 2*pi > 1).
character_compatibility_equivalence.hyperbolic_null_cone_explanation: Functional-equation symmetry rho <-> 1 - conj(rho) satisfies chi_{1-conj(rho)}(V_K) = conj(chi_rho(V_K^*)). For delta != 0, any V_K^* = V_{-K}-invariant Hermitian form B(., .) on span{e_rho, e_{1-conj(rho)}} satisfies B(e_rho, e_rho) = tau^{2 K delta} B(e_rho, e_rho) and B(e_{1-conj(rho)}, e_{1-conj(rho)}) = tau^{-2 K delta} B(e_{1-conj(rho)}, e_{1-conj(rho)}), forcing isotropic diagonal B_{11} = B_{22} = 0 and signature-(1, 1) hyperbolic quadratic form 2 Re(B_{12} conj(c_1) c_2) with eigenvalues +/- |B_{12}|.

multiplicity_and_jordan_socle_audit.socle_theorem_statement: By Meyer (arXiv:math/0412277 Cor. 4.2 & Thm. 5.8), each nontrivial zero rho of xi(s) with multiplicity m_rho = ord_xi(rho) >= 1 contributes the finite-dimensional generalized eigenspace E_rho = ker((^t D_- - rho)^{m_rho}) of dimension m_rho >= 1. Even if m_rho > 1 and ^t D_- has a non-trivial nilpotent Jordan part N_rho on E_rho, the socle ker(^t D_- - rho) subset E_rho has dimension >= 1, and any nonzero socle vector l_{rho,0} in ker(^t D_- - rho) \ {0} is a strict eigenvector satisfying U_K l_{rho,0} = tau^{K(rho - 1/2)} l_{rho,0}. Thus Target 1 requires only a positive inner product on the socle (or a semisimple multiplicity-weighted eigenspace) and never assumes simplicity of zeros.

scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.scalar_correlation_boundedness_equivalen: RH <==> sup_{K in A_R} |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) <==> sup_{K in A_R} |C_tau(K)| < infty holds unconditionally in zero multiplicity m_rho >= 1 in BOTH directions: (i) Under RH (Re(rho) = 1/2), each distinct zero rho = 1/2 + i*gamma_rho of multiplicity m_rho = ord_xi(rho) >= 1 is a simple pole of -xi'(s)/xi(s) with residue m_rho, so -F_tau(s) F_tau(1-s) (xi'(s)/xi(s)) tau^{-K(s-1/2)} has residue m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 tau^{-i K gamma_rho} (with no polynomial drift in K), giving |C_tau(K)| <= sum_{rho distinct} m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 = C_tau(0) < infty; (ii) Conversely, by the Fixed-Seed RH Equivalence Theorem (TASK-TC-037 / Theorem 12), sup_{K in A_R} |C_tau(K)| < infty implies RH via Laplace-Carleman analytic continuation without assuming zero simplicity.
scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.socle_operator_unitary_realization_equiv: Realizing the socle eigenvectors l_{rho,0} in ker(^t D_- - rho) \ {0} (or a semisimple multiplicity-weighted eigenspace) in a positive-definite inner-product space with V_K^* = V_{-K} is equivalent to Re(rho) = 1/2 for all zeros (RH alone, arbitrary m_rho >= 1).
scalar_correlation_vs_operator_jordan_sc.full_generalized_eigenspace_unitary_real: Realizing the full generalized-eigenvector operator action on Meyer's cotangent quotient H_-^0 = (+) E_rho as a unitary representation on a Hilbert space is equivalent to RH + Simplicity (Re(rho) = 1/2 and m_rho = 1 for all zeros), because for m_rho >= 2 the nilpotent Jordan chain V_K l_{rho,1} = tau^{K(rho-1/2)} (l_{rho,1} + (K log tau) l_{rho,0}) has norm growing linearly in |K|.

meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.quotient_space: H_-^0 = H_- / Z(H_+ intersect H_-) (Meyer arXiv:math/0412277 Cor. 4.2)
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.spectrum_and_multiplicities: Spec(^t D_- | (H_-^0)') = {rho in C : xi(rho) = 0} with algebraic multiplicity dim ker((^t D_- - rho)^N) = ord_xi(rho) >= 1.
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.trace_formula_theorem_5_8: chi(rho)(f) = Tr(rho_-(f) | H_-^0) = sum_p W_p(f) + W_inf(f) = -W_xi(f) for admissible test functions f (Meyer Theorem 5.8).
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.ambient_L2_completion_obstruction: Completing H_-^0 in the ambient critical-line Hilbert norm ||[h]||_{L^2(1/2+iR)} (where ||[h]||^2 = (1/tau) int_{-infty}^infty |hat{h}(1/2+it)|^2 dt) makes U_K unitary, but off-critical point evaluation [h] |-> hat{h}(1/2 + delta_0 + i*gamma_0) (delta_0 != 0) is unbounded in ||.||_{L^2(1/2+iR)} and therefore does NOT extend to the ambient L^2 completion.
meyer_0412277_spectral_realization.convolution_trace_pairing_preservation: Equipping H_-^0 with the convolution-trace pairing <[g], [h]>_W := -chi(rho_-)(g * h^*) = W_xi(g * h^*) preserves every nontrivial zero rho of xi(s) (with multiplicity ord_xi(rho)) in the spectral expansion and makes U_K isometric because (U_K g) * (U_K h)^* = g * h^*.

connes_consani_2006_13771_compressed_sca.compressed_trace_identity_prop_2_2: Tr(theta(g * g^*) P P_hat) = int_{1/2}^2 (g * g^*)(rho) delta(rho) d^* rho for supp(g) subset [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}] (arXiv:2006.13771 Prop. 2.2 & Appendix A).

separated_grade_support_extension.explanation: While a single compactly supported g in [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}] has supp(g * g^*) subset (1/2, 2) (reaching only the archimedean place and p = 2 at the boundary), separated grade shifts h_{K-L} = (T_K psi_tau) * (T_L psi_tau)^* translate the center of mass to X_{K-L} = tau^{|K-L|}, crossing p = 2 at |K - L| = log(2)/log(tau) = 0.377146..., p = 3 at 0.597864..., and activating arbitrarily large primes p <= tau^{|K-L|} as |K - L| grows.

connes_consani_moscovici_2511_22755_zeta.operator_construction: Compresses the scaling generator D_0 = -i x d/dx to the finite-dimensional wavelet/prolate subspace QW_lambda(N) subset L^2([-lambda, lambda])_{ev} and applies the rank-one perturbation k_CCM = E(h_CCM) = (1/8) x^{1/2} psi_tau to obtain D_{lambda, N} with regularized determinant det_reg(D_{lambda, N} - z) = -i lambda^{-i z} hat{xi}_{lambda, N}(z) (Theorem 1.1 & Section 5).
connes_consani_moscovici_2511_22755_zeta.self_adjoint_vs_rank_one_perturbed_reali: Before the rank-one perturbation, the compressed scaling operator is self-adjoint with real spectrum (visual zeros on the real axis corresponding to Re(s) = 1/2). After the rank-one perturbation enforcing exact vanishing at the first N zeros of xi, D_{lambda, N} is a rank-one perturbation of a self-adjoint operator whose reality of spectrum is equivalent to those zeros lying on the critical line.
section_8_two_missing_steps: Step 1 (Irrational multi-prime alignment, arXiv:2511.22755 Section 8): Extend the caricature model (where log p are commensurable rational multiples of a single period so the Euler product collapses to a finite trigonometric polynomial with real zeros) to the actual incommensurable logarithms {log p} of distinct primes.

Step 2 (Inductive N -> N + 1 zero-location step, arXiv:2511.22755 Section 8): Prove that the high-accuracy real-axis visual zeros of the self-adjoint compression persist as genuine critical-line zeros as the cutoff dimension N and scaling parameter lambda -> infty.

positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.two_sided_vs_one_sided_shift_reconciliat: With (S_x f)(y) = f(xy) and (S_x^{-1} f)(y) = f(y/x), the inherited TC-042F/TC-043 Attempt B one-sided shift-difference (A_tau^B f)(x, y) = f(y) - f(y/x) satisfies int_0^infty ((A_tau^B T_K f)(x, y)) conj((A_tau^B f)(x, y)) dy/y = 2 h_0(e^kappa) - h_0(e^{kappa + u}) - h_0(e^{kappa - u}) (kappa = |K| log tau, u = log x). By contrast, a two-sided difference f(xy) - f(y/x) would evaluate to 2 h_0(e^kappa) - h_0(e^{kappa + 2u}) - h_0(e^{kappa - 2u}) (doubling the log-shift u -> 2u) unless x is replaced by x^{1/2} via the isometric change of variable y |-> x^{-1/2} y.
positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.isometric_embedding_J_tau: J_tau(f) := (A_tau^B f, 2 R_0 f) in H_tau^pos = H_tau^B (+) L^2(R_{>0}, dy/y), where (R_0 f)(y) := int_0^y (t/y)^{1/2} (D f)(t) dt/t = f(y) - (1/2) int_0^y (t/y)^{1/2} f(t) dt/t (with Euler derivative D = y d/dy) is the causal s = 0 pole-resolvent with Mellin multiplier it / (1/2 + it) and 4 <R_0 T_K psi_tau, R_0 psi_tau>_{L^2(dy/y)} = 4 h_0(e^kappa) - J(kappa), J(kappa) := int_0^infty e^{-u/2} (h_0(e^{kappa+u}) + h_0(e^{kappa-u})) du.

euler_resolvent_R0_and_pole_integral_J_k.pole_integral_J_kappa_definition: J(kappa) := int_0^infty e^{-u/2} (h_0(e^{kappa+u}) + h_0(e^{kappa-u})) du = int_1^infty x^{-1/2} (h_0(e^kappa x) + h_0(e^kappa x^{-1})) dx/x
euler_resolvent_R0_and_pole_integral_J_k.attempt_B_weight_vs_J_kappa_weight_disti: In J(kappa), the exponential weight is e^{-u/2} du = x^{-1/2} dx/x (arising from the L^2(R_{>0}, dy/y) convolution of the s = 0 pole kernel k_0(y) = y^{-1/2} 1_{y>1}). By contrast, the weight (e^{-3u/2} / (2 sinh u)) du = (x^{-3/2} / (x - x^{-1})) dx/x belongs to the Attempt B conductor space H_tau^B difference-square integral P_tau^B(K) = int_0^infty (e^{-3u/2} / (2 sinh u)) (2 h_0(e^kappa) - h_0(e^{kappa+u}) - h_0(e^{kappa-u})) du.

positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.unitary_representation_and_intertwining: U_K (phi, psi) := (U_K^B phi, T_K psi) for all K in A_R, where (U_K^B phi)(x, y) = phi(x, tau^{-K} y) and (T_K psi)(y) = psi(tau^{-K} y) are unitary dilations with U_K^* = U_{-K}, satisfying the exact intertwining identity J_tau(T_K f) = U_K J_tau(f).
positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.hilbert_schmidt_seed_operator_B_0: B_0 := |Psi_0^pos><e_0| in HS(H_tau^pos), where Psi_0^pos := J_tau(psi_tau) = (A_tau^B psi_tau, 2 R_0 psi_tau) and e_0 in H_tau^pos is a fixed unit vector (||e_0|| = 1), with left unitary orbit B_K := U_K B_0 = |U_K Psi_0^pos><e_0|.
positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.pole_integral_J_kappa_cancellation_ident: <A_tau^B T_K psi_tau, A_tau^B psi_tau>_{H_tau^B} = W_arch(h_K) + c_tau^B h_0(X_K) - (2 h_0(X_K) - J(kappa)) and 4 <R_0 T_K psi_tau, R_0 psi_tau>_{L^2(dy/y)} = 4 h_0(X_K) - J(kappa) (where J(kappa) = int_0^infty e^{-u/2} (h_0(e^{kappa+u}) + h_0(e^{kappa-u})) du has exponential weight e^{-u/2}, while P_tau^B(K) has weight e^{-3u/2}/(2 sinh u)), so J(kappa) cancels identically in their sum P_tau(K) = W_arch(h_K) + (c_tau^B + 2) h_0(X_K).
positive_hilbert_space_and_unitary_orbit.matrix_coefficient_identity: P_tau(K) := <B_K, B_0>_{HS} = <U_K Psi_0^pos, Psi_0^pos>_{H_tau^pos} = <A_tau^B T_K psi_tau, A_tau^B psi_tau>_{H_tau^B} + 4 <R_0 T_K psi_tau, R_0 psi_tau>_{L^2(dy/y)} = W_arch(h_K) + (c_tau^B + 2) h_0(tau^{|K|}) = W_arch(h_K) + c_tau^A h_0(tau^{|K|}).

exact_decomposition_and_controlled_remai.decomposition_formula: C_tau(K) = P_tau(K) + E_tau(K),   E_tau(K) = E_{tau,controlled}(K) - R_{mu,band}(tau^{|K|})

cutoff_definitions_tc049r.M_X_clamped_exact_characterization: M >= 2  and  X^5 <= M^4  and  (M = 2  or  (M - 1)^4 < X^5)   (for X >= 1, integer M)
cutoff_definitions_tc049r.M_X_helper_location_and_scope: certified_coupled_cutoff_M_X_arb in tc/prime_euler_moebius_recovery.py computes M_safe(X_ball) = max(2, int(((X_ball^5)^{1/4}).upper().ceil())) and certifies X_ball^5 <= M_safe^4 (a certified safe upper cutoff across X_ball). certify_clamped_exact_cutoff_M_X_arb in tc/faithful_tau_arithmetic_spectral_realization.py additionally verifies the clamped lower condition (M = 2 or (M - 1)^4 < X_ball^5) so M_safe(X_ball) = M(X) is exact on X_ball whenever (X_ball^5)^{1/4} does not straddle an integer >= 2.
cutoff_definitions_tc049r.R_mu_head_formula: R_{mu,head}(X) := sum_{2 <= m <= H(X)} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m)  (0 when H(X) < 2)
cutoff_definitions_tc049r.divisor_vs_prime_cutoff_distinction: H(X) and M(X) are divisor cutoffs on the integer index m in the full Moebius sum R_mu(X) = sum_{m>=2} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m). By contrast, y in the prime-sieved approximant W_y(X) = sum_{m | P_y} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m) is a prime factor cutoff (restricting to squarefree m with P^+(m) <= y, where max divisor is P_y = exp(vartheta(y))). For y >= M(X), every squarefree m <= M(X) divides P_y, so the shared head+band terms 2 <= m <= M(X) cancel in W(X) - W_y(X).

h0_autocorrelation_cauchy_schwarz_and_si.valid_global_bound_derivation: By the multiplicative autocorrelation identity h_0(tau^{|K|}) = <T_{|K|} psi_tau, psi_tau>_{L^2(dy/y)} and unitary dilation Cauchy-Schwarz on L^2(R_{>0}, dy/y), |h_0(X_K)| <= ||T_{|K|} psi_tau||_{L^2} ||psi_tau||_{L^2} = ||psi_tau||_{L^2}^2 = h_0(1) for all K in R (and independently by the symmetric Bernstein bound |h_0(X)| <= (92193/32768) (X + X^{-1})^{-5/2} <= h_0(1), Lean Theorem 5).

exact_decomposition_and_controlled_remai.controlled_remainder_formula: E_{tau,controlled}(K) = -(c_tau^B + 2) h_0(X_K) - W(X_K^{-1}) - W_log(X_K) - R_{mu,head}(X_K) - R_{mu,tail}(X_K),   X_K = tau^{|K|} >= 1

component_1_pole_plus_transfer_h0.inequality_used: Unitary dilation Cauchy-Schwarz on L^2(R_{>0}, dy/y): |h_0(X_K)| = |<T_{|K|} psi_tau, psi_tau>_{L^2(dy/y)}| <= ||psi_tau||_{L^2(dy/y)}^2 = h_0(1) = 92193 / (512 * 2^{17/2}) = 0.49736248380990124... (note: h_0 changes sign on [1, infty), with h_0(2) = -0.217430622... < 0, so the bound uses Cauchy-Schwarz / Bernstein envelope |h_0(X_K)| <= (92193/32768)(X_K + X_K^{-1})^{-5/2} <= h_0(1), NOT monotonicity), giving global bound B_{h_0} = c_tau^A h_0(1) and large-X_K asymptotic h_0(X_K) ~ -(81/64) X_K^{-5/2} = O(X_K^{-5/2}) with |h_0(X_K)| <= (92193/32768) X_K^{-5/2}.
component_1_pole_plus_transfer_h0.provenance: Multiplicative autocorrelation Cauchy-Schwarz on L^2(R_{>0}, dy/y) + TASK-TC-040 symmetric Bernstein envelope (Lean Theorem 5) + TASK-TC-042F/043 (c_tau^A = c_tau^B + 2).
component_1_pole_plus_transfer_h0.rounding_direction: Outward-rounded Arb ball enclosure (.upper() provides certified upper bound).

component_2_reflected_small_scale_prime_.inequality_used: |W(X_K^{-1})| <= (92193/32768) (sum_{n=2}^infty Lambda(n)/n^3) X_K^{-5/2} <= B_refl (computed via prime powers n <= 25000 plus Rosser-Schoenfeld tail 1.558245 / 25000^2).
component_2_reflected_small_scale_prime_.provenance: TASK-TC-043 / TASK-TC-044 prime-power cubic tail majorant.
component_2_reflected_small_scale_prime_.rounding_direction: Outward-rounded Arb ball enclosure (.upper() provides certified upper bound).

component_3_divisor_aggregated_W_log_XK.inequality_used: Global bound |W_log(X_K)| <= B_log := 30731/98304 + M_{tilde{h},0}^{(-3/2)} + (1/2) M_{tilde{h},log}^{(-3/2)} for all X_K >= 1, and large-scale decay |W_log(X_K)| <= C_{log,EM} X_K^{-5/2} for X_K > 0.
component_3_divisor_aggregated_W_log_XK.provenance: TASK-TC-044 (7-root total-variation global bound) and TASK-TC-049R (Euler-Maclaurin decay constant C_{log,EM}).
component_3_divisor_aggregated_W_log_XK.rounding_direction: Outward-rounded Arb ball enclosure (.upper() provides certified upper bound).

Note: extending the head to floor(X/2) cannot use |W_log(u)| <= C u^{-5/2} to claim decay because X^{-5/2} sum_{2 <= m <= X/2} m^2 = O(X^{1/2}) grows like sqrt(X) (though failure of this unsigned majorant does not prove the signed Moebius head sum is unbounded).
component_4_head_divisor_R_mu_head_XK.rounding_direction: Outward-rounded Arb ball enclosure (.upper() provides certified upper bound).

component_5_super_scale_tail_R_mu_tail_X.inequality_used: |R_{mu,tail}(X_K)| <= C_{log,0} X_K^{5/2} sum_{m > M(X_K)} m^{-3} <= C_{log,0} X_K^{5/2} / (2 M(X_K)^2) <= (1/2) C_{log,0} =: B_tail (proved uniform O(1) bound, since M(X_K) >= X_K^{5/4} implies X_K^{5/2} / M(X_K)^2 <= 1).

exact_decomposition_and_controlled_remai.large_grade_asymptotic_behavior_of_E_tau: As |K| -> infty (X_K = tau^{|K|} -> infty): the first three components decay rapidly as |(c_tau^B + 2) h_0(X_K)| = O(X_K^{-5/2}) (with h_0(X_K) ~ -(81/64) X_K^{-5/2}), |W(X_K^{-1})| = O(X_K^{-5/2}), and |W_log(X_K)| <= C_{log,EM} X_K^{-5/2} = O(X_K^{-5/2}), while at the TC-049/TC-049R cutoffs H(X_K) = floor(X_K^{5/6}) and M(X_K) = ceil(max(2, X_K^{5/4})) the head and tail satisfy the proved uniform O(1) bounds |R_{mu,head}(X_K)| <= (5/6) C_{log,EM} and |R_{mu,tail}(X_K)| <= (1/2) C_{log,0}. Consequently, sup_{K in A_R} |E_{tau,controlled}(K)| <= B_ctrl < 17.987140 and limsup_{|K|->infty} |E_{tau,controlled}(K)| <= (5/6) C_{log,EM} + (1/2) C_{log,0} < 11.502478 (establishing o(1) decay of R_{mu,head} would require cancellation or a strictly smaller exponent < 5/6, and o(1) decay of R_{mu,tail} requires a cutoff growing faster than X_K^{5/4}).

parallel_connes_consani_hilbert_schmidt_.half_line_projection_orbit_B_0_Sigma: B_0^Sigma := theta(tilde{psi}_tau)^* P P_hat in HS(L^2(R)_{ev}) gives P_tau^Sigma(K) = <U_K B_0^Sigma, B_0^Sigma>_{HS} = Tr(theta(h_K) P P_hat) and W_arch(h_K) = P_tau^Sigma(K) - D_tau(K), where D_tau(K) is the archimedean trace defect.
parallel_connes_consani_hilbert_schmidt_.sonin_projection_orbit_B_0_Sonin: B_0^Sonin := theta(tilde{psi}_tau)^* S in HS(L^2(R)_{ev}) (where S projects onto Sonin's space) gives P_tau^Sonin(K) = <U_K B_0^Sonin, B_0^Sonin>_{HS} = Tr(theta(h_K) S) and W_arch(h_K) = P_tau^Sonin(K) - E_{tau,prolate}(K).

theorem_51_tau_grade_star_involution_and.parameters: (tau K J delta B11 B12 B22 c1 c2 : ℝ) (htau : 1 < tau) (hK : K ≠ 0) (hB12 : 0 < B12)
definitions_used: gradeRadialCharacter (tau K delta : ℝ) := tau ^ (K * delta)
hyperbolicPairForm (B12 c1 c2 : ℝ) := 2 * B12 * c1 * c2
jordanTwoByTwoSocleStep (lam c0 c1 : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ := (lam * c0 + c1, lam * c1)
proved_conjuncts: gradeRadialCharacter tau (K + J) delta = gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta * gradeRadialCharacter tau J delta ∧ gradeRadialCharacter tau (-K) delta = gradeRadialCharacter tau K (-delta)
gradeRadialCharacter tau (-K) delta = gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta ↔ delta = 0

delta ≠ 0 → (tau ^ (2 * K * delta) - 1) * B11 = 0 → (tau ^ (-(2 * K * delta)) - 1) * B22 = 0 → (B11 = 0 ∧ B22 = 0 ∧ B11 * c1 ^ 2 + 2 * B12 * c1 * c2 + B22 * c2 ^ 2 = hyperbolicPairForm B12 c1 c2 ∧ 0 < hyperbolicPairForm B12 1 1 ∧ hyperbolicPairForm B12 1 (-1) < 0)

jordanTwoByTwoSocleStep (gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta) 1 0 = (gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta, 0) ∧ jordanTwoByTwoSocleStep (gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta) 0 1 = (1, gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta) ∧ (jordanTwoByTwoSocleStep (gradeRadialCharacter tau K delta) 0 1).1 ≠ 0

remaining_open_obligation.exact_statement: Prove uniform boundedness sup_{X >= 1} |R_{mu,band}(X)| < infty of the localized resonant-band Moebius sum R_{mu,band}(X) = sum_{H(X) < m <= M(X)} (mu(m)/sqrt(m)) W_log(X/m) with H(X) = floor(X^{5/6}) and M(X) = ceil(max(2, X^{5/4})), or equivalently construct a positive Hilbert-space inner product on Meyer's cotangent quotient H_-^0 for which the grade-translation representation U_K is unitary and the socle zero functionals l_{rho,0} are bounded.
